description: Unit: the authoring-rate resolver prefers an exact contract-currency price, falls back to default_rate when absent, preserves a configured zero, and reports none for invalid input.
Component: GenericContractLineServicesList shows and submits default_rate without rendering a required manual-rate input when the contract-currency price is absent.
Component: GenericContractLineServicesList uses an exact contract-currency price ahead of default_rate and still blocks an unresolved selection until a valid manual rate is entered.
Component: ServiceSelectionDialog returns the resolved rate in customRate and typeConfig and excludes products for hourly and usage lines while allowing them for fixed lines.
Component: selecting multiple fixed services seeds the recurring base rate with the quantity-weighted resolved-rate sum and updates it for replacement, removal, and quantity changes.
Component: a manually edited or resumed fixed base rate remains unchanged after service changes, while a missing or zero base rate continues to fail fixed-line validation.
Component: FixedContractLineConfiguration seeds only an empty base-rate field from its service total and never replaces an existing value.
DB integration happy path: add a tenant-owned service membership with a fallback-resolved custom rate and verify the stored configuration and type-specific rate use integer minor units.
DB integration guard: reject or ignore a cross-tenant service membership addition and verify no configuration row is written for the target contract line.
Submission unit: fixed-service draft rate/source metadata is omitted from ClientContractWizardSubmission while service id, name, and quantity remain intact.
